body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success against Composure, make it Exposed; you may also make it Possessed.

surges.html: Choose one creature or object affected by this Action as the Rite's sympathetic link. The Rite may trigger from that link within 6 units as though it were at the Rite's location.
If this Rite triggers because of an ally, that ally becomes Rallied.

rider.title: HEX RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The hexed creature deals damage. Echo: It becomes Exposed after the triggering Action resolves.
